issue.title: Refresh stale generated sase_gate provider skills
issue.description: While verifying sase-cc with just check, SASE validation failed only at init skills --check because five generated sase_gate provider SKILL.md copies in the chezmoi source need a +6-line refresh (agy, claude, codex, opencode, qwen). The current sase-cc changes touch only Rust bead CLI rendering and one fast-path test docstring, so generated skill deployment is distinct follow-up work. Reproduce with just check or .venv/bin/sase validate, then refresh the generated copies through the supported skill initialization workflow and verify validation passes.
